narrative.overview:
ODDLY is a gallery wall with a Calder mobile in front of it. The page is cream paper set with very large, very condensed black capitals and a quiet editorial text voice; in front of and behind that type hang three painted sculptures, one per discipline: a coral matte-ceramic loop (Creative), a charcoal lacquered-metal quatrefoil (Technology), and a lavender/sage pair of clay discs (Automation). As the reader scrolls, the installation re-balances into a new pose per section, and hairline charcoal wires appear when the pieces are shown as a connected system or as a mobile at rest. Type is the architecture; the sculptures are the event.

Density is low and the scale contrast is extreme: display capitals measured against the viewport sit beside 15-17px Inter, with almost nothing in between except a Plus Jakarta lead voice. Structure comes from a 12-column grid, charcoal hairline rules, and generous section padding, never from boxes, cards, or tinted panels. Every section composes itself differently inside the same tokens; repetition of a layout across sections is a failure, repetition of a token is the system.

Colour is disciplined: cream ground, charcoal ink, coral as the single loud signal. Lavender and sage belong to Automation and to the project art swatches; they never become general UI accents.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground, charcoal ink, coral as the only loud signal.
Archivo black at 62% width, uppercase, line-height 0.84, sized to the viewport.
Three procedural 3D sculptures in brand materials, posed per scene and layered between "back" and "front" type planes.
Charcoal hairlines (1px) as the only connective line, on the page and as wires in 3D.
Flat paper; depth comes from the real-time shadows of the sculptures, not from UI shadows.
Coral underlines (2px) as the link and call-to-action language.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only loud colour on any cream page. It marks endings, links, and the active hover; it does not fill panels or backgrounds on the home page.

rules.name: The Discipline Colour Rule
rules.body: Lavender and sage belong to Automation (and to project art swatches). They never become generic UI accents, button fills, or decorative tints.

rules.name: The Five-Swatch Rule
rules.body: Project art (case-study title fields, placeholder plates) is set only from the five brand swatches as ground / ink / accent triples. A cream plate on the cream page moves to deeper paper so it never vanishes.

rules.name: The Condensed Capitals Rule
rules.body: Display type is always Archivo 900 at width 62, uppercase, line-height 0.84. Display sizes are bound to the viewport (vw and vh), not to a fixed rem ramp.

rules.name: The Sentence Voice Rule
rules.body: Anything read as a sentence is Plus Jakarta or Inter in sentence case. Capitals belong to display only.

rules.name: The Coral Full Stop Rule
rules.body: The brand dot is a coral disc (0.2em) that ends a display line or wordmark, used only where a sentence or name ends.

rules.name: The Paper Is Flat Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons, nav, and plates outside the collage carry no shadow. If something needs to feel lifted, it is a sculpture, not a box.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body: Coral is matte fired ceramic (roughness 0.66, pitted grain), charcoal is lacquered painted metal (clearcoat 1), lavender and sage are clay (roughness 0.78, fine grain). No glass, chrome, glow, or iridescence.

dos: Do set display type in Archivo 900, width 62, uppercase, line-height 0.84, sized to the viewport.
Do keep coral to signals: the full stop, 2px underlines, the CTA hover, selection, and the focus halo.
Do build structure with 1px charcoal rules (rule-hair inside lists, rule-strong to open a block) on the 12-column grid.
Do give every section its own composition on the shared tokens; vary placement, not values.
Do mark every placeholder plate "Imagery in preparation" until real media replaces it.
Do use the authored 24px, 1.75px square-cap arrows for directional links and nudge them in their direction on hover.
Do keep small text at ink-mute (5.6:1) or darker, and keep the charcoal outline plus coral halo on every focusable element.
Do unpin every scroll scene below 900px and hold the opening pose under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use lavender or sage as general UI accents; they belong to Automation and project art.
Don't put drop shadows on cards, buttons, or nav; the only lifted UI is the hung plate in the collage.

Don't wrap content in rounded cards or decorative tinted panels; use rules, whitespace, and the grid. Coloured fields are reserved for case-study title fields and plates set from the project swatch triple.
Don't set sentences in display capitals or set display in anything other than condensed Archivo.
Don't render the sculptures in glass, chrome, glow, or gradients; they are ceramic, lacquered metal, and clay.
Don't introduce colours outside the five brand swatches and their documented ink/paper derivatives.
